items.q: Is my password sent to any servers?
items.a: No. All calculations are performed locally in your browser using the zxcvbn engine. For the breach check, we use k-anonymity, sending only the first 5 characters of your password's hash, which is mathematically impossible to reverse-engineer into your original password.
Entropy measures the randomness of a password in bits. Higher entropy means there are more possible combinations, making it exponentially harder for computers to guess.

items.q: Why should I use a long password instead of a complex one?
items.a: Length is generally more effective against brute-force attacks than character complexity. A 20-character simple sentence is often harder to crack than an 8-character complex string.
